costs.intro: A BMW Z4 3.0i  3.0si engine rebuild starts from
costs.body: A BMW Z4 3.0i or 3.0si engine rebuild starts from £2,800, whether your car has the M54 or the N52. A full replacement engine and fitting service is also available. Exact pricing depends on the condition of your existing engine and the parts required — submit your registration for a fixed-price quote within 30 minutes.
